steps.description:
Read up the notes on FILE IO (read and write).

Click here to view the notes.

The instructor will then brief you on the topic.

Write a program that asks user to enter a filename. It will then create a file with that filename. If the file already exists, the content will be overwritten (erased). Display "file created" upon the file creation.

In replit, the files will appear on the left panel as shown below. Click on it to view or edit the content.


Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - Use the file open mode "w". Refer to the notes to understand what this mode is for.

Test Input data.txt

text.dat

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below: Check that the file is created after entering the name

Example 1 Input filename: data.txt file created

Example 2 Input filename: text.dat file created

Write a program that will call a function to perform the following: 1. Create a file named data.txt. It the file already exists, it should be overwritten. 2. Asks user to enter a string and saves it on a new line in the file. 3. Repeat step (2) until user enters "end".

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - A newline character is represented by "\n" - In order to save a string on a new line in a file, you need to add the newline character manually

Test Input treasure chestbox end

apple orange Hello there! end

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the exa Example 1 Enter text: treasure Enter text: chestbox Enter text: end

data.txt should contain the following: treasure chestbox

Example 2 Enter text: apple Enter text: orange Enter text: Hello there! Enter text: end

data.txt should contain the following: apple orange Hello there!

In replit, you can copy a file by creating a file using the add file command and copy and paste contents into it from another replit file.


Copy data.txt from the previous question.

Write a program which calls a function to perform the following: 1. Open the file data.txt created from the previous question. 2. Read and display all the lines of text. Remove any extra newlines between the text. 3. The program will display "end of file" after all the text in the file is being displayed.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - Use the file open mode "r". Refer to the notes to understand what this mode is for.

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

The following contents were written to the file in previous step apple orange Hello there! end of file

Copy data.txt from the previous question.

Write a program that calls a function to perform the following: 1. Open the file data.txt created from the previous question. 2. Ask user to enter a string and append it to the file. Each entry should be on a new line in the file. 3. Repeat step (2) until user enters "end".

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - Use the file open mode "a". Refer to the notes to understand what this mode is for.

Test Input bubble tea latte mocha long black end

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the example below: Enter text: bubble tea Enter text: latte mocha Enter text: long black Enter text: end

data.txt should contain the following after appending: apple orange Hello there! bubble tea latte mocha long black
